tools.name: get_stock_quote
tools.description: Latest price snapshot for an NSE stock — last close, prev close, change %, day H/L, volume.

tools.name: get_ohlc_data
tools.description: Recent OHLCV candles. timeframe in {daily, 15min, 5min}; limit capped at 500; newest first.

tools.name: get_technical_indicators
tools.description: Latest technical indicators (EMAs, SMAs, RSI, MACD, BB, ADX, Stoch, ATR, OBV, VWAP).

tools.name: get_support_resistance
tools.description: Pivot points + historical support/resistance levels, ordered by price desc.

tools.name: get_demand_supply_zones
tools.description: Demand/supply zones (DBR/RBR/RBD/DBD) split into demand_zones and supply_zones.

tools.name: get_candlestick_patterns
tools.description: Recent single-bar candlestick patterns (HAMMER, DOJI, ENGULFING, ...) newest first.

tools.name: get_fibonacci_levels
tools.description: Latest fibonacci retracement swings (UP/DOWN) with 236/382/500/618/786 levels.

tools.name: get_volume_analysis
tools.description: Volume diagnostic: top 5min hotspots + peak slot + OBV 20-day trend + today/20-day volume ratio.

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Market-wide snapshot: indices, top_gainers, top_losers, most_active, breadth.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 symbols: quote, RSI/MACD/ADX, trend, 30d return, latest pattern.

tools.name: screen_stocks
tools.description: Filter the active universe. Keys: rsi_min, rsi_max, adx_min, trend, near_demand_zone, pattern, min_volume_ratio, sector. At least one required.
